set.rappel_count_note: Three full 60 m rappels down the route itself, through trees, which the first-ascent party found faster than the shared Cutthroat Wall walk-off. They are two-rope rappels: the party tagged a second 60 m rope to make them, since one 60 m rope doubled reaches only 30 m. No intermediate stations are described, so with one rope, take the walk-off. Only the first anchor is specifically located: a tree up and left of the pitch 5 belay.
